en.s: The Battle of Philippi was the final battle in the Liberators' civil war between the forces of Mark Antony and Octavian (of the Second Triumvirate) and the leaders of Julius Caesar's assassination, Brutus and Cassius, in 42 BC, at Philippi in Macedonia. The Second Triumvirate declared the civil war ostensibly to avenge Julius Caesar's assassination in 44 BC, but the underlying cause was a long-brewing conflict between the Optimates and the Populares.
en.n: Liberators' civil war: Mark Antony and Octavian decisively defeat an army under Brutus in the second part of the Battle of Philippi, with Brutus committing suicide and ending the civil war.

zh.s: 腓立比战役是公元前42年解放者内战的最后一场战斗，发生在马其顿腓立比。交战双方是第二次三头同盟的马克·安东尼和屋大维，以及参与刺杀尤利乌斯·恺撒的布鲁图和卡西乌斯。第二次三头同盟表面上宣称发动内战是为报复恺撒于公元前44年遇刺，根本原因则是最优化派与平民派之间长期积累的冲突。
zh.n: 解放者内战：马克·安东尼和屋大维在腓立比战役第二阶段决定性击败布鲁图率领的军队；布鲁图自杀，内战结束。

en.t: The Synodus Palmaris, called by Gothic king Theoderic, absolves Pope Symmachus of all charges, thus ending the schism of Antipope Laurentius
en.s: Pope Symmachus (died 19 July 514) was the bishop of Rome from 22 November 498 to his death on 19 July 514. His tenure was marked by a serious schism over who was elected pope by a majority of the Roman clergy.

zh.t: 帕尔马里会议解除教宗西马库斯的所有指控，结束劳伦提乌斯对立教宗引发的分裂
zh.s: 西马库斯教宗（卒于514年7月19日）于498年11月22日起担任罗马主教，直至去世。他任内发生严重分裂，争议焦点是罗马教士多数选出的教宗人选。

en.s: The Battle of Sagrajas (23 October 1086), also called Zalaca or Zallaqa (Arabic: معركة الزلاقة‎, translit. Maʿrakat az-Zallāqa‎), was a battle between the Almoravid army led by the Almoravid king Yusuf ibn Tashfin and a Christian army led by the Castilian King Alfonso VI. The battleground was later called az-Zallaqah (in English "slippery ground") because the warriors were slipping all over the ground due to the tremendous amount of blood shed that day, which gave rise to its name in Arabic.

zh.s: 萨格拉哈斯战役于1086年10月23日爆发，又称扎拉卡战役或扎拉卡（阿拉伯语：معركة الزلاقة，转写：Maʿrakat az-Zallāqa）。优素福·伊本·塔什芬率领的阿尔摩拉维王朝军队与阿方索六世率领的卡斯蒂利亚基督教军队交战。由于当天大量流血，战场上到处湿滑，后来被称为az-Zallaqah，意为“滑地”，阿拉伯语名称由此而来。

en.s: The Battle of Grathe Heath was fought in 1157 between the Danish armies of Valdemar I and his rival for the Danish throne, Sweyn III. Valdemar's forces won the battle, and Sweyn III was slain while attempting to flee.

zh.s: 格拉瑟荒原之战发生于1157年，交战双方是丹麦国王瓦尔德马一世的军队与其王位竞争者斯文三世的军队。瓦尔德马一世获胜，斯文三世在逃跑时被杀。

en.t: The first treaty forming the Auld Alliance between Scotland and France against England is signed in Paris
en.s: The Auld Alliance (Scots for "Old Alliance") was an alliance between the kingdoms of Scotland and France against England made in 1295. The Scots word auld, meaning old, has become a term for the long-lasting association between the two countries. The alliance was never formally revoked, although it is considered by some to have ended with the signing of the Treaty of Edinburgh in 1560.

zh.t: 苏格兰与法国在巴黎签署反英《古老同盟》首份条约
zh.s: 《古老同盟》（苏格兰语称“Old Alliance”）是1295年苏格兰王国与法国王国为对抗英格兰而缔结的联盟。苏格兰语auld意为“古老”，后来成为两国长期结盟关系的称呼。该联盟从未正式废止；不过，有些人认为它随着1560年《爱丁堡条约》的签署而结束。

en.s: The Battle of Sark, or the Battle of Lochmaben Stone, was fought between Scotland and England on 23 October 1448 or 1449. It was a decisive Scottish victory, the first since the Battle of Otterburn in 1388, and the last pitched battle to be fought between the two kingdoms during the Medieval period.

zh.s: 萨克战役又称洛赫马本石战役，是苏格兰和英格兰之间的一场战斗，发生于1448年或1449年10月23日。苏格兰取得决定性胜利，这是自1388年奥特本战役以来的首次胜利，也是中世纪两国之间最后一场会战。

en.s: The siege of Oldenzaal was a short siege that took place during the Eighty Years' War and the Anglo–Spanish War by a Dutch and English army led by Maurice of Orange of the city of Oldenzaal from 20 to 23 October 1597. The city surrendered to the overwhelming Dutch and English force. The siege was part of Maurice's campaign of 1597 known as the Ten Glory Years, his highly successful offensive against the Spaniards.

zh.s: 奥尔登扎尔围城战是八十年战争和英西战争期间的一场短暂围城战，由毛里茨亲王率领的荷兰和英国军队于1597年10月20日至23日围攻奥尔登扎尔。该城面对人数占绝对优势的荷兰和英国军队，最终投降。此次围城是毛里茨1597年“十年辉煌”战役的一部分，该战役是他对西班牙人发起的一场非常成功的攻势。

en.s: The Siege of Kanizsa was a siege that took place in 1600. The Ottoman army under the command of Tiryaki Hasan Pasha captured the Kanizsa Castle as a result of the siege that lasted between September 10 and October 23, 1600.

zh.s: 卡尼日萨围城战发生于1600年。蒂里亚基·哈桑帕夏指挥的奥斯曼军队围攻卡尼日萨城堡，于1600年9月10日至10月23日围城结束后攻占该堡。

en.s: The Battle of Ostróda was a battle that took place on the 23rd of October 1628 in Ostróda during the Polish–Swedish War (1626–1629) between the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth commanded by Hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Jakub Butler against the Swedish Empire commanded by colonel Wolf Heinrich von Baudissin. It resulted in a Polish victory.

zh.s: 奥斯特罗达战役于1628年10月23日在波兰—瑞典战争期间爆发，地点在波兰奥斯特罗达。斯坦尼斯瓦夫·科涅茨波尔斯基和雅库布·巴特勒指挥的波兰立陶宛联邦军队与沃尔夫·海因里希·冯·鲍迪辛上校指挥的瑞典帝国军队交战。波兰方面获胜。

en.s: The Irish Rebellion of 1641 began on 23 October 1641. Initiated by Irish gentry and military officers, the rebellion sought to end English domination of Ireland, restore lands confiscated through the plantations of Ireland, and secure Irish control over the country's government and affairs. Planned as a swift coup d'état to gain control of the Protestant-dominated central government, it instead developed into the 1641–1653 Irish Confederate Wars, part of the wider Wars of the Three Kingdoms.

zh.s: 1641年爱尔兰叛乱于1641年10月23日爆发。爱尔兰贵族和军官发起叛乱，意图结束英格兰对爱尔兰的统治、收回爱尔兰殖民拓垦期间被没收的土地，并争取爱尔兰人控制本国政府和事务。叛乱原计划迅速发动政变，控制由新教徒主导的中央政府，但最终演变为1641至1653年的爱尔兰邦联战争，成为更广泛的三王国战争的一部分。

en.s: The Battle of Edgehill (or Edge Hill) was the first pitched battle of the First English Civil War. It was fought near Edge Hill and Kineton in southern Warwickshire on Sunday, 23 October 1642. All attempts at constitutional compromise between King Charles and Parliament broke down early in 1642. Both King and Parliament raised large armies to gain their way by force of arms. In October, at his temporary base near Shrewsbury, King Charles decided to march on London in order to force a decisive confrontation with Parliament's main army, commanded by the Earl of Essex.

zh.s: 埃奇希尔战役又称埃奇山战役，是第一次英国内战中的首场会战，于1642年10月23日星期日在沃里克郡南部埃奇希尔和基内顿附近爆发。1642年初，国王查理和议会之间所有宪政妥协方案均告破裂。双方都组建了大军，准备以武力争胜。10月，查理国王在什鲁斯伯里附近的临时驻地决定向伦敦进军，迫使自己与埃塞克斯伯爵指挥的议会主力军决战。

en.s: The sieges of Ceuta, also known as the thirty-year siege, were a series of blockades by Moroccan forces of the Spanish-held city of Ceuta on the North African coast. The first siege began on 23 October 1694 and finished in 1720 when reinforcements arrived. During the 26 years of the first siege, the city underwent changes leading to the loss of its Portuguese character.

en.s: The Sack of Sarajevo took place on 23 October 1697 and was committed by raiding Austrian troops led by Prince Eugene of Savoy. At this time the Great Turkish War was being fought. Shortly after the Austrian victory at the Battle of Zenta (today: Senta, Serbia), an opportunity arose for the Austrians to launch a surprise attack into Ottoman Bosnia.

zh.s: 1697年10月23日，萨伏依的欧根亲王率领奥地利突袭部队劫掠萨拉热窝。当时正值大土耳其战争。奥地利在曾塔战役（今塞尔维亚森塔）获胜后不久，出现了突袭奥斯曼波斯尼亚的机会。

en.s: The Battle of Vigo Bay, also known as the Battle of Rande (Galician: A Batalla de Rande; Spanish: Batalla de Rande) was a naval engagement fought on 23 October 1702 during the opening years of the War of the Spanish Succession. The engagement followed an Anglo-Dutch attempt to capture the Spanish port of Cádiz in September in an effort to secure a naval base in the Iberian Peninsula. From this station the Allies had hoped to conduct operations in the western Mediterranean Sea, particularly against the French at Toulon.

zh.s: 维戈湾海战又称兰德海战（加利西亚语：A Batalla de Rande；西班牙语：Batalla de Rande），于1702年10月23日爆发，是西班牙王位继承战争初期的一场海战。此前，英荷联军于9月试图攻占西班牙港口加的斯，以在伊比利亚半岛建立海军基地。盟军原希望以此为据点在地中海西部开展行动，尤其是打击土伦的法国军队。

en.s: The siege of Mons took place between 19 September and 23 October 1709 during the War of the Spanish Succession. It saw a Franco-Spanish garrison in the fortified town of Mons, then in the Spanish Netherlands, besieged by a force of the Duke of Marlborough's Grand Alliance army under the command of the Prince of Orange.

zh.s: 1709年9月19日至10月23日，西班牙王位继承战争期间发生蒙斯围城战。马尔伯勒公爵率领的大同盟军由奥兰治亲王指挥，围攻当时位于西属尼德兰、设有防御工事的蒙斯城，城内驻有法西联军守军。

en.s: The siege of Isfahan (Persian: سقوط اصفهان) was a six-month-long siege of Isfahan, the capital of the Safavid dynasty of Iran, by the Hotaki-led Afghan army. It lasted from March to October 1722 and resulted in the city's fall and the beginning of the end of the Safavid dynasty.

en.s: The Battle of Buxar was fought between 22 and 23 October 1764, between the forces of the British East India Company, under the command of Major Hector Munro, against the combined armies of Shah Alam II, the Emperor of the Mughal Empire; Mir Qasim, the Nawab of Bengal; Balwant Singh, the Maharaja of the Benares State; Shuja-ud-daula, the Nawab of Awadh.

zh.s: 布克萨尔战役于1764年10月22日至23日爆发，交战双方是赫克托·蒙罗少校指挥的英国东印度公司军队，以及由莫卧儿帝国皇帝沙阿拉姆二世、孟加拉纳瓦布米尔·卡西姆、贝拿勒斯邦大君巴尔万特·辛格和奥德纳瓦布舒贾-乌德-道拉共同率领的联军。

en.s: Ali Pasha (1743 – 24 January 1822), commonly known as Ali Pasha of Yanina or Ali Pasha of Tepelena, was an Albanian ruler who served as pasha of the Pashalik of Yanina, a large part of western Rumelia, in the Ottoman Empire. Under his rule, it acquired a high degree of autonomy and even managed to stay de facto independent.

zh.t: 尼科波利斯之战：雅尼纳的阿里帕夏击败法军并攻占普雷韦扎
zh.s: 阿里帕夏（1743年—1822年1月24日），通常称雅尼纳的阿里帕夏或特佩莱纳的阿里帕夏，是阿尔巴尼亚统治者，曾任奥斯曼帝国雅尼纳帕夏领地的帕夏。该领地覆盖鲁米利亚西部大片地区。在他的统治下，该地区获得高度自治，甚至一度事实上独立。

en.s: The Battle of Venta del Pozo, also known as the Battle of Villodrigo by the French and Spanish, was a rear-guard action fought as part of the Peninsular War on 23 October 1812 between an Anglo-German force led by Major-General Stapleton Cotton and Marquess of Wellington against French troops under Major-Generals Pierre François Xavier Boyer and Jean-Baptiste Théodore Curto.

zh.s: 文塔德尔波索战役又称法国和西班牙所称的比略德里戈战役，是半岛战争期间的一场后卫战，于1812年10月23日爆发。斯特普尔顿·科顿少将和惠灵顿侯爵率领的英德联军与皮埃尔·弗朗索瓦·泽维尔·博耶和让-巴蒂斯特·泰奥多尔·屈尔托少将指挥的法军交战。

en.s: The Malet coup of 1812 was an attempted coup d'état in Paris, France, aimed at removing Napoleon I, then campaigning in Russia, from power. The coup was engineered by general Claude François de Malet, a republican who had consistently opposed Napoleon. Malet used forged documents to convince French National Guard officers in Paris that Napoleon had died, enabling him to take control of elements of the guard and use them to arrest various government ministers.

zh.s: 1812年马莱政变是法国巴黎发生的一场未遂政变，目标是推翻当时正在俄罗斯作战的拿破仑一世。共和派将军克洛德·弗朗索瓦·德·马莱策划了政变，他一贯反对拿破仑。马莱使用伪造文件，骗法国国民卫队军官相信拿破仑已死，借此控制部分卫队，并逮捕多名政府部长。

en.s: The National Women's Rights Convention was an annual series of meetings that increased the visibility of the early women's rights movement in the United States. First held in 1850 in Worcester, Massachusetts, the National Women's Rights Convention combined both female and male leadership and attracted a wide base of support including temperance advocates and abolitionists.
en.n: The first National Women's Rights Convention begins in Worcester, Massachusetts.

zh.s: 全国妇女权利大会是一系列年度会议，提升了美国早期妇女权利运动的关注度。首届大会于1850年在马萨诸塞州伍斯特举行。大会男女共同担任领导，并吸引了禁酒运动倡导者和废奴主义者等广泛群体参与。

en.s: The Battle of Westport, sometimes referred to as the "Gettysburg of the West," was fought on October 23, 1864, in modern Kansas City, Missouri, during the American Civil War. Union forces under Major General Samuel R. Curtis decisively defeated an outnumbered Confederate force under Major General Sterling Price. This engagement was the turning point of Price's Missouri Expedition, forcing his army to retreat. The battle ended the last major Confederate offensive west of the Mississippi River, and for the remainder of the war the United States Army maintained solid control over most of Missouri.

zh.s: 韦斯特波特战役有时称为“西部的葛底斯堡”，于1864年10月23日在美国内战期间于今密苏里州堪萨斯城发生。塞缪尔·R·柯蒂斯少将率领的联邦军决定性击败了人数较少的邦联军，后者由斯特林·普赖斯少将率领。这场战斗是普赖斯密苏里远征的转折点，迫使其军队撤退。战役终结了密西西比河以西邦联军最后一次大规模攻势；此后，联邦军在余下的战争期间牢牢控制了密苏里州大部分地区。

en.t: Meiji Restoration: Having taken the shogunate's seat of power at Edo and declared it his new capital as Tokyo, Mutsuhito proclaims the start of the new Meiji era
en.s: The Meiji Restoration (明治維新, Meiji Ishin; also translated as the Meiji Reform[ation]), referred to at the time as the Honorable Restoration (御維新／御一新, Goi(s)shin), was a political event that restored imperial rule to Japan in 1868 under Emperor Meiji and led to the Westernisation of Japan. Although there were ruling emperors before the Meiji Restoration, the events restored practical power to, and consolidated the political system under, the Emperor of Japan.

zh.t: 明治维新：睦仁占领幕府权力中心江户并将其定为新都东京，宣布明治新时代开始
zh.s: 明治维新（明治維新，Meiji Ishin；也译作明治改革）是1868年日本发生的一场政治变革，在明治天皇统治下恢复了天皇实权，并推动日本走向西化。当时称其为“御维新／御一新”（御維新／御一新，Goi(s)shin）。明治维新前虽已有在位天皇，但这场变革恢复并巩固了日本天皇的实际权力和以天皇为中心的政治体制。

en.s: The Assommoir bombing was a bomb attack carried out on 23 October 1882 around 2:00 A.M. by anarchist Fanny Madignier, a member of the Louise Michel-Marie Ferré group, and at least two accomplices against L'Assommoir, a restaurant associated with the Lyonnese bourgeoisie. This was the first deadly anarchist attack in French history, although the intent to kill is unclear.

zh.s: 1882年10月23日凌晨约2时，无政府主义者范妮·马迪尼耶与至少两名同伙在“路易丝·米歇尔—玛丽·费雷”团体成员身份下，对里昂资产阶级常去的阿索姆瓦尔餐馆发动炸弹袭击。这是法国历史上首起致命的无政府主义袭击，但是否有意杀人尚不清楚。

Mandor can be translated to construction foreman in Indonesian language. This was the Dutch view of events — i.e. as an area already under Dutch rule, where that rule was threatened by an uprising.

en.s: The Battle of Kumanovo (Serbian: Кумановска битка / Kumanovska bitka, Turkish: Kumanova Muharebesi), on 23–24 October 1912, was a major battle of the First Balkan War. It was an important Serbian victory over the Ottoman army in the Kosovo Vilayet, shortly after the outbreak of the war. After this defeat, the Ottoman army abandoned the major part of the region, suffering heavy losses in manpower (mostly due to desertions) and in war materiel.

zh.s: 库马诺沃战役（塞尔维亚语：Кумановска битка／Kumanovska bitka；土耳其语：Kumanova Muharebesi）于1912年10月23日至24日爆发，是第一次巴尔干战争中的一场重要战役。塞尔维亚军队击败科索沃维拉耶特的奥斯曼军队，取得重要胜利。战败后，奥斯曼军队放弃了该地区大部分领土，人员和装备损失惨重，人员损失主要是逃兵所致。

en.s: The Battle of Sălătrucu was a military engagement during the Romanian Campaign of World War I. It took place after the Battle of Transylvania and resulted in a Romanian victory. en.s: The Battle of Wadi Musa was fought between the Arab Army and the Ottoman Empire during the Arab Revolt of 1916–1918. The battle began when General Djemal Pasha ordered his forces to secure the Hejaz Railway by "any and all means necessary". The Ottoman Army at Ma'an was sent to deal with the North Arab Army. The Ottomans were ambushed by 700 Arab troops, inflicting heavy casualties and capturing 300 men.

zh.s: 瓦迪穆萨之战发生于1916至1918年阿拉伯起义期间，交战双方是阿拉伯军队和奥斯曼帝国军队。杰马尔帕夏将军下令“不惜一切代价”确保汉志铁路安全，战斗由此爆发。迈安的奥斯曼军队奉命对付北方阿拉伯军。奥斯曼军队遭700名阿拉伯士兵伏击，伤亡惨重，另有300人被俘。

en.s: The Hamburg Uprising (German: Hamburger Aufstand) was an insurrection during the Weimar Republic in Germany. It was started on 23 October 1923 by one of the most militant sections of the Hamburg district Communist Party (KPD), the KP Wasserkante. From a military point of view, the attempt was futile and it was over within 24 hours. Rebels stormed 24 police stations, 17 in Hamburg and seven in Schleswig-Holstein Province in Prussia. Over 100 people died during the uprising. The exact details of the uprising, as well as the assessment of its impact, are controversial to this day.

zh.s: 汉堡起义（德语：Hamburger Aufstand）是魏玛共和国时期德国的一场武装起义，由汉堡共产党（KPD）内最激进的派别之一“水岸区共产党”于1923年10月23日发动。从军事角度看，这次行动徒劳无功，24小时内便告结束。起义者袭击了24个警察局，其中17个在汉堡，另外7个在普鲁士的石勒苏益格-荷尔斯泰因省。起义造成100多人死亡。时至今日，起义的具体情况及其影响仍存在争议。

en.t: The Imatra Cinema is destroyed in a fire in Tampere, Finland, during showing the 1924 film Wages of Virtue; 21 people die in the fire and almost 30 are injured
en.s: Imatra was a cinema in Tampere, Finland, located in Hämeenkatu 12. The theatre was built in an old warehouse. The outer walls of the building were made of brick, but the interior structures were made of wood. On October 23, 1927, the cinema was destroyed in a fire. The cinema was showing Wages of Virtue (1924), featuring Gloria Swanson, and about 200 people were in the audience, about 80 of whom were in the balcony.

zh.t: 伊马特拉电影院放映《美德的代价》期间发生火灾，21人死亡、近30人受伤
zh.s: 伊马特拉电影院位于芬兰坦佩雷哈梅恩卡图12号，由一座旧仓库改建而成。影院外墙为砖砌，内部结构则由木材制成。1927年10月23日，影院发生火灾并被烧毁。当时影院正在放映1924年电影《美德的代价》，由格洛丽亚·斯旺森主演。约200名观众在场，其中约80人在楼座。

en.s: The 1935 FA Charity Shield was the 22nd FA Charity Shield, a football match between the winners of the previous season's First Division and FA Cup competitions. zh.s: 1935年英格兰足总慈善盾杯是第22届慈善盾杯，由上赛季英格兰甲级联赛和足总杯冠军进行比赛。联赛冠军阿森纳与足总杯冠军谢菲尔德星期三在阿森纳主场海布里球场交锋，谢菲尔德星期三以1比0获胜。

en.s: Federal elections were held in Australia on 23 October 1937. All 74 seats in the House of Representatives, and 19 of the 36 seats in the Senate were up for election. The incumbent United Australia Party led by Prime Minister of Australia Joseph Lyons with coalition partner the Country Party led by Earle Page defeated the opposition Australian Labor Party led by John Curtin. The election is notable in that the Country Party (later the National Party) achieved its highest-ever primary vote in the lower house, thereby winning nearly a quarter of all lower house seats.

zh.s: 澳大利亚于1937年10月23日举行联邦大选，改选众议院全部74席和参议院36席中的19席。由澳大利亚总理约瑟夫·莱昂斯领导的执政联合澳大利亚党与埃尔·佩奇领导的乡村党联盟，击败了由约翰·柯廷领导的反对党澳大利亚工党。此次选举值得注意的是，乡村党（后来的国家党）在众议院的初选得票率创下历史最高纪录，赢得了近四分之一的众议院席位。

en.s: The Battle off Sept-Îles was a naval battle fought on the night of 22 and 23 October 1943 during World War II as part of the Atlantic campaign. The battle took place in the off the Sept-Îles near the French coast in the English Channel between a light cruiser and six destroyers of the British Royal Navy, and a minesweeper and torpedo boat flotillas of the German Kriegsmarine hoping to intercept and escort a blockade runner. The battle ended with HMS Charybdis being sunk and the destroyer Limbourne being scuttled after suffering damage; nearly 500 British sailors lost their lives in the battle.

zh.s: 塞特岛海战于1943年10月22日至23日夜间在第二次世界大战大西洋战役期间爆发。战场位于英吉利海峡法国海岸附近的塞特岛外海，交战双方是英国皇家海军一艘轻巡洋舰和六艘驱逐舰，以及德国海军的一艘扫雷舰和鱼雷艇舰队；德军试图拦截并护送一艘突破封锁的船只。英国皇家海军“查里布迪斯”号沉没，驱逐舰“林伯恩”号受损后被凿沉，近500名英国水兵在战斗中丧生。

en.s: The Battle of Leyte Gulf is generally considered to be the largest naval battle of World War II and, by some criteria, possibly the largest naval battle in history It was fought in waters near the Philippine islands of Leyte, Samar and Luzon, from 23–26 October 1944, between combined American and Australian forces and the Imperial Japanese Navy. On 20 October, United States troops invaded the island of Leyte as part of a strategy aimed at isolating Japan from the countries it had occupied in Southeast Asia, and in particular depriving its forces and industry of vital oil supplies.

zh.s: 莱特湾海战通常被认为是第二次世界大战中规模最大的海战，按照某些标准，也可能是历史上规模最大的海战。1944年10月23日至26日，美澳联军与日本帝国海军在菲律宾莱特岛、萨马岛和吕宋岛附近海域交战。10月20日，美国军队为切断日本与其东南亚占领区之间的联系，并剥夺日军及其工业所需的重要石油供应，入侵莱特岛。

en.s: The Battle of Vukov Klanac was a 7-day fight between Wehrmacht and Yugoslav Partisan forces in central Dalmatia. The battle occurred between 15 and 23 October 1944. It resulted in the 369th Devil's Division losing most of its equipment and a large fraction of its manpower to Partisan forces.

zh.s: 武科夫克拉纳茨战役是国防军与南斯拉夫游击队在达尔马提亚中部进行的一场为期7天的战斗，发生于1944年10月15日至23日。战场位于梅特科维奇和斯通之间，德军正从附近的杜布罗夫尼克和斯通撤退。游击队击溃了德军第369师，使其损失大部分装备和大量兵员。

en.s: A referendum was held in the State of Vietnam (South Vietnam) to determine whether the country was a republic or monarchy. It was primarily a contest between Prime Minister Ngô Đình Diệm, who proposed a republic, and former emperor Bảo Đại, who had abdicated in 1945 and at the time of the referendum held the title of chief of state. The referendum was the last phase in the power struggle between Bảo Đại and his prime minister. In June 1954, Bảo Đại had appointed Diệm in recognition of his staunch anticommunist and anticolonialist stance, as well as his potential to secure American aid. The country was then going through a period of insecurity, as Vietnam had been partitioned as a result of the 1954 Geneva Accords that ended the First Indochina War. The State of Vietnam controlled the southern half of the country, pending national elections that were intended to reunify the country under a single government. Still, the Vietnamese National Army was not in full control of southern Vietnam; the Cao Đài and Hòa Hảo religious sects ran their own administrations in the countryside supported by private armies, while the Bình Xuyên organised crime syndicate controlled the streets of Saigon. Despite interference from these groups, Bảo Đại, and French officials, Diệm managed to subdue the private armies and consolidate government control over the country by mid-1955. Emboldened by his success, Diệm began to plot Bảo Đại's downfall. He scheduled a referendum for 23 October 1955 and pushed Bảo Đại out of the political scene, hindering the former emperor's attempts to derail the poll.

zh.s: 越南国于1955年举行公投，以决定国家采取共和国还是君主制。主要对决双方是主张建立共和国的总理吴廷琰，以及1945年退位、在公投时仍保留国家元首头衔的前皇帝保大。此次公投是保大与总理之间权力斗争的最后阶段。1954年6月，保大任命吴廷琰，认可其坚定的反共、反殖民立场以及争取美国援助的潜力。当时，越南因结束第一次印度支那战争的1954年日内瓦协定而分裂。越南国控制南部，原计划通过全国选举重新统一国家。尽管如此，越南国民军尚未完全控制南越；高台教和和好教在乡村自行管理，并拥有私人武装，平川派有组织犯罪集团则控制西贡街道。面对这些势力、保大及法国官员的干预，吴廷琰到1955年年中成功镇压私人武装并巩固政府控制。吴廷琰因此信心大增，开始谋划推翻保大。他将公投定于1955年10月23日，并把保大逐出政治舞台，阻止这位前皇帝破坏投票。

en.s: The third Iranian Assembly of Experts election was held on October 23, 1998 to elect all 86 members in 28 constituencies. 17,857,869 citizens voted in the elections, marking a 46.3% turnout. Coming a year after reformist Mohammad Khatami's 1997 presidential victory, there had been speculation that reform-minded individuals would do well in the 1998 race. However, the Guardian Council changed the rules. Previously, candidates had to demonstrate ijtihad, but in 1998 all potential candidates were also required to demonstrate a "proper political inclination". Out of 396 individuals registered to run, 167 (36.86%) were qualified by the council. 214 were disqualified, 13 withdrew and 60 of 187 invitees did not participate in ijtihad test.

zh.s: 伊朗于1998年10月23日举行第三届专家会议选举，在28个选区选出全部86名成员。共有17,857,869名公民投票，投票率为46.3%。改革派穆罕默德·哈塔米于1997年赢得总统选举后，曾有人预测改革派将在1998年选举中表现出色。但宪法监护委员会更改了规则：此前候选人须证明自己具备教法学资格，1998年则还须证明其“政治倾向适当”。396名登记参选者中，167人（36.86%）获委员会认可，214人被取消资格，13人退出，另有187名获邀者中60人没有参加教法学考试。

en.s: The Chūetsu earthquakes (中越地震 Chūetsu jishin) occurred in Niigata Prefecture, Japan, at 17:56 local time (08:56 UTC) on Saturday, October 23, 2004. The Japan Meteorological Agency (JMA) named it the "Heisei 16 Niigata Prefecture Chuetsu Earthquake" (平成16年新潟県中越地震 Heisei ju-roku-nen Niigata-ken Chuetsu Jishin). Niigata Prefecture is located in the Hokuriku region of Honshu, the largest island of Japan. The initial earthquake had a magnitude of 6.6 and caused noticeable shaking across almost half of Honshu, including parts of the Tōhoku, Hokuriku, Chūbu, and Kantō regions.

zh.s: 2004年10月23日星期六当地时间17:56（世界协调时08:56），日本新潟县发生中越地震（中越地震，Chūetsu jishin）。日本气象厅将其命名为“平成16年新潟县中越地震”（平成16年新潟県中越地震，Heisei ju-roku-nen Niigata-ken Chuetsu Jishin）。新潟县位于日本最大岛本州的北陆地区。首次地震震级为6.6级，本州近一半地区都有明显震感，包括东北、北陆、中部和关东地区的部分区域。

en.s: Hurricane Patricia was the most powerful tropical cyclone on record worldwide in terms of maximum sustained winds. It was also the second-most intense on record worldwide in terms of pressure, with a minimum atmospheric pressure of 872 mbar (25.75 inHg), just behind Typhoon Tip's 870 mbar (25.69 inHg). Originating from a sprawling disturbance near the Gulf of Tehuantepec, south of Mexico, in mid-October 2015, Patricia was first classified as a tropical depression on October 20.
en.n: The lowest sea-level pressure in the Western Hemisphere, and the highest reliably-measured non-tornadic sustained winds, are recorded in Hurricane Patricia, which strikes Mexico hours later, killing at least 13 and causing over $280 million in damages.

en.s: The 2025 Caerphilly by-election was held on 23 October 2025 to elect the new member of the Senedd (MS) for the Senedd constituency of Caerphilly following the death of Hefin David on 12 August 2025. Former Senedd member Lindsay Whittle of Plaid Cymru won the by-election with 47% of the vote, ending more than a hundred years of Labour representation in UK Parliament and Senedd elections in Caerphilly, and outperforming expectations of a closer race between Plaid Cymru and Reform UK.

zh.s: 卡菲利选区于2025年10月23日举行补选，选出威尔士议会卡菲利选区的新任议员。补选起因是海芬·戴维于2025年8月12日去世。威尔士党前议员林赛·惠特尔以47%的得票率获胜，结束了工党在英国议会和威尔士议会卡菲利选举中逾百年的代表地位，其表现也胜过了此前对威尔士党与改革英国党竞争更为胶着的预期。
